description: Candidate historical design corpus for the independent design-review experiment. Non-normative, not frozen, and not an experiment result. A candidate is a document that existed before the defect was recorded; remediation plans are evidence pointers, not corpus inputs.

author_evidence.uncertainty: A Git identity does not prove who wrote or directly edited a document. The repository history shows only the operator as a human identity; AI co-author trailers are not human adjudicators. The operator is treated as an author or direct editor for adjudication purposes.

candidates.defect_summary: The acceptance matrix claims the project lock protects CLI, MCP, and ACP equally. The gap report shows the lock is metadata-only and is not held for execution, so CLI-first and ACP-first exclusion is unresolved.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm the plan revision, permitted code references, and determinability before freeze.

later_evidence: The plan's own post-merge status line; no independent later report was found.
candidates.defect_summary: Retrieval was wired to IMPLEMENT but not FIX despite the original implement/fix scope. The evidence is part of the document, so it is self-referential.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must either locate an independent later pointer or keep this plan excluded.
candidates.exclusion_reason: The only later-evidence pointer is the plan's own post-merge status line; a reviewer at the pre-fix revision would not see it.

candidates.defect_summary: Six operator acceptance checks fail after a later `### Acceptance Mapping` contract; the plan remains ACTIVE.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must decide whether a defect created by a later contract is admissible and fix the pre-fix revision.

later_evidence: The plan's status and the LLM04 evidence report.
candidates.defect_summary: Historical outcomes remain PARTIAL until re-execution under the newly recorded acceptance mapping.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm whether this is a design defect or a later acceptance-contract change.

candidates.pre_fix_note: e5d45fc1 is the plan revision before the LLM02 fix merge aa23217; the later disclosure report is not part of the reviewer input.
candidates.defect_summary: Acceptance-check logs, model-visible validation failures, and JSON-escaped Go test output exposed credential-shaped text; all three were fixed later. The pre-fix plan at e5d45fc1 precedes the fix merge aa23217.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm e5d45fc1 as the pre-fix revision and keep the disclosure report out of the reviewer input.

candidates.defect_summary: Residual scanner findings and dependency-coverage gaps remain after the add-on's first acceptance.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm which residual findings were knowable at the pre-fix plan revision.

candidates.defect_summary: This is a follow-up to the historicalized Plan 08 and records confirmed hidden-context defects. Using it as the corpus document would leak the answer.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must locate the pre-fix Plan 08 artifact and revision.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Remediation/follow-up plan contains the answer; parent Plan 08 artifact is required.

candidates.defect_summary: The plan required follow-up evidence for retrieval cancellation, deadlines, and rebuild/invalidation. The follow-up plan records the gap.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must locate the pre-fix Plan 09 artifact and revision.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Remediation/follow-up plan contains the answer; parent Plan 09 artifact is required.

candidates.defect_summary: The spec states that the outcome verdict is diagnostic and never read back to drive a decision. PARTIAL could therefore reach LOCAL_DONE; the hardening plan makes required criteria gate the lifecycle.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must decide whether a deliberate non-gating design is a design defect or a later policy change.

candidates.defect_summary: The spec leaves a PENDING approval in place after an accepted plan reconciliation; if its evidence is obsolete, the task is deadlocked. The invalidation repair is later.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm the parent revision and whether the reconcile/approval interaction was in scope.

candidates.defect_summary: The reuse cache identity lacked an effective content digest, a validation scope, and toolchain/command-policy inputs; the store was per-project and reuse was an opaque blob. The plan records these as verified gaps.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm whether the spec or the implementation owned the cache identity gaps.

candidates.defect_summary: The pre-fix recovery contract did not cover the limitation the Phase 5 plan later resolved; the plan records the prior limitation and the bounded recovery design.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm the exact pre-fix limitation and whether it was design-level.

candidates.defect_summary: The pre-fix REVIEW spec already requires invocation-scoped input and a deterministic malformed-output boundary. The recorded defects were implementation defects, not design-document defects.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must keep this plan excluded or provide a different pre-fix design artifact.
candidates.exclusion_reason: The design spec already specified the correct behavior; the defect was in code.

candidates.defect_summary: Three residual review-governance findings recorded at the Review-Governance-Hardening closure. The parent design artifact has not been identified.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must identify the pre-fix artifact and revision.

candidates.defect_summary: The lifecycle-consistency audit recorded gaps in transition legality, state ownership, and concurrency; the remediation plan records them but was not implemented.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm the pre-fix revision and whether the audit findings are design-level.

candidates.defect_summary: The convergence investigation recorded failure signatures and termination arithmetic that the pre-fix agent-boundary spec did not fully constrain.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm whether the spec omission is determinable from the pre-fix artifact.

candidates.defect_summary: The pre-fix artifact contract did not provide a reliable provider-independent token count or the observability the run-metrics plan later required.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must confirm the pre-fix revision and whether the metrics gap was design-level.

candidates.defect_summary: The context-engine live-path evaluation recorded gaps in the pre-fix architecture; the evaluation plan is the later evidence.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must identify a narrower pre-fix artifact and revision.

candidates.defect_summary: Cross-cutting readiness gaps across adapters, Windows, Julia, rollback and observability; no single pre-fix design artifact contains the defect.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must keep this plan excluded or define a composite artifact.
candidates.exclusion_reason: No single pre-fix design artifact; the defects are cross-cutting readiness gaps.

candidates.defect_summary: Cross-cutting end-to-end reliability gaps; the parent design artifact and pre-fix revision have not been identified.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must identify the pre-fix artifact and revision.

candidates.defect_summary: The RAG evaluation produced a NO-GO. A negative result is not a demonstrated design defect in the plan.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must keep this excluded unless a specific plan defect is identified.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Evaluation negative result, not a defect in the plan.

candidates.defect_summary: The plan records live-model and Linux verification as NOT_RUN. That is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated design defect.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must keep this excluded or supply a demonstrated defect.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Evidence gap, not a demonstrated design defect.

candidates.defect_summary: The plan is PROPOSED and not implemented; no later evidence pointer records a defect.
candidates.outstanding_decision: Corpus owner must keep this excluded unless a design defect is identified independently.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Proposed plan with no later defect evidence.
